tool.name: C.Origami Predict
tool.description: Predict Hi-C contact maps using Hi-cGAN
tool.command:
bash $__tool_directory__/run_tool.sh && mkdir -p corigami_data/bigwig/ && mkdir -p corigami_data/fasta &&
cp $bigwig_atac corigami_data/bigwig/ATAC.bw && cp $bigwig_ctcf corigami_data/bigwig/CTCF.bw && cp -r $fasta_seq corigami_data/fasta/ &&
echo "${model.fields.path}" && ls -lah "${model.fields.path}" && ln -s "${model.fields.path}" model.keras && #set $input_folder_bigwig="corigami_data/bigwig/" #set $input_folder_fasta="corigami_data/fasta/"
which corigami-predict && ls -lah corigami_data/bigwig/ && ls -lah corigami_data/fasta/ &&
corigami-predict \ --out outputFolder \ --celltype IMR90 \ --chr chr1 \ --start 0 \ --model corigami_data/model_weights/corigami_base.ckpt \ --seq "${input_folder_fasta}" \ --ctcf "${input_folder_bigwig}/CTCF.bw" \ --atac "${input_folder_bigwig}/ATAC.bw" \ --full-chr \ --chr-len "${chromosome_size}" \ --gpu 1 &&
mv outputFolder/IMR90/chr1_cooler_output.cool $output

param.name: bigwig_atac
param.label: Input ATAC data
param.help: Select an ATAC-seq as bigWig file.

param.name: bigwig_ctcf
param.label: Input CTCF data
param.help: Select an CTCF (from ChIP-seq) input as bigWig file.

param.name: fasta_seq
param.label: Input DNA sequence
param.help: Select a DNA sequence as FASTA file.

param.name: chromosome_size
param.label: Chromosome size
param.help: Select a chromosome size file as TXT file.

param.name: chromosomes
param.label: Prediction Chromosomes (comma-separated)
param.help: Enter chromosomes separated by commas, e.g., chr1,chr2,chr3

tool.help:
This tool predicts Hi-C contact maps from chromatin folders using a pre-trained HiC-GAN model.
**Inputs:** - Chromatin folder containing bigWig files. - Select a preinstalled model. - Chromosomes to predict. - Output file for parameters.
**Output:** - A .cool file containing the predicted Hi-C contact map. - A .txt file with prediction parameters.
